about.title: Good software starts with clarity.
about.lead: I’m a full stack engineer who likes hard problems, clean interfaces, and teams that care about the craft.
body: Over five years at Ninthroot, I’ve led the development of consumer-facing web experiences across distinct brands while contributing to the systems behind them — from a PHP-based framework and CMS to purpose-built internal platforms.
I work comfortably across the stack, but my strongest contribution is connecting the layers: product goals, user experience, system architecture, delivery practices, and the people doing the work.

I earned my B.S. in Computer Science from Utah Valley University with Summa Cum Laude honors. Curiosity still drives how I work: learn the system, ask better questions, and leave things stronger than I found them.
